decision.rationale: Official UBC STEM Writing Resources for Learning offers substantive freely available teaching and learning materials for students and educators. Public student and instructor resources are useful despite additional instructor-only material requiring access; the homepage is not authentication-only and states no exclusively Okanagan mandate.
evidence: https://scwrl.ubc.ca/ | 1e4ccda5597ebf0cf8c303d9f7f2c2e9327d116260b8806c801e4480ee774696 | The STEM Writing Resources for Learning (ScWRL) provides freely available materials for teaching and learning in STEM communication.

https://scwrl.ubc.ca/ | 1e4ccda5597ebf0cf8c303d9f7f2c2e9327d116260b8806c801e4480ee774696 | Our team aims to provide students with the resources needed to communicate effectively, and to provide educators with the tools needed to support students as they develop their writing skills.

https://scwrl.ubc.ca/ | 1e4ccda5597ebf0cf8c303d9f7f2c2e9327d116260b8806c801e4480ee774696 | Communicating in STEM Disciplines; Features of Academic STEM Writing; STEM Writing Tips; Academic Integrity in STEM; Strategies for Writing; Instructor Resources

rules.rationale: The homepage explicitly lists these teaching and learning sections for STEM communication and academic writing.
rules.title_pattern: ^(?:Communicating in STEM Disciplines|Features of Academic STEM Writing|STEM Writing Tips|Academic Integrity in STEM|Strategies for Writing|Instructor Resources)

fallback.rationale: STEM communication teaching and learning materials for UBC students and educators.
